notes.title: Dream Knight released !
notes.content:
Hello, fellow gamers, "Dream Knight" was officially launched in March 2021. It took more than 2 years of development. During this period, it experienced repeated lockdowns due to the epidemic, repeated refinements of gameplay, and frame-by-frame polishing of character animations. Today, it is finally ready. It’s reached the point where I can take it out for everyone to see.
Try it if you like!

notes.title: Our game will be officially released on November 14th
notes.content:
Hello everyone~
Our action arcade pigeon game "Dream Knight" will be officially launched on November 14th.
The game contains 4 characters, 7 weapons, dozens of talents, a variety of props, and multiple builds to complete the level with ease.
To thank everyone for your continued attention to our games, we will launch a 15% off new game discount in the first week. Don't miss this opportunity!

notes.title: The demo festival is here, and our demo has also been updated
notes.content: The game is getting more and more perfect now, but at the same time, we also need your feedback. The demo version released this time has 2 levels, 2 weapons, knives and double knives. I hope you have time to try the demo, and at the same time you can use It would be better if our games were added to your wishlist

notes.title: 《Dream Knight》 is participating in the "Oriental Game Culture Week" event!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43511705/d3d4f12bd835ae6a0f22c6800dd31779d3c464a8.png[/img]

《Dream Knight》 is pleased to announce that we are participating in the "Oriental Game Culture Week" event hosted by the steam platform!
During the "Oriental Game Culture Week" event, a demo version of "Game Name" will be launched in conjunction with this event, providing players with a free trial experience.
In the demo version, players can experience the smooth combat experience and some functions of the game. If you like our game, please add a wish list and give us some support!

notes.title: 《Dream Knight》is participating in the "Oriental Game Culture Week" activities
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43511705/d3d4f12bd835ae6a0f22c6800dd31779d3c464a8.png[/img]

《Dream Knight》 is pleased to announce that we are participating in the "Oriental Game Culture Week" event hosted by the steam platform!
During the "Oriental Game Culture Week" event, a demo version of "Game Name" will be launched in conjunction with this event, providing players with a free trial experience.
The demo version provides players with a trial level, where players can experience the smooth operation of the game and the casting of skills. Heroic spirits, pets, etc. also have a certain chance to appear in the level, and they can be summoned if they are encountered.
"Fantasy Knight" looks forward to meeting all connoisseurs who love games at the "Oriental Game Culture Week" event.
